<div class="card-body">
'''Danz Borin''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ダンズ・ボーリン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に3を加える。2：宇宙船に乗客として乗り組むなら、宇宙船の兵器の武器運命数に1を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Danz-Borin-PSA-160005369.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">うぬぼれ屋の砲手でバウンティー・ハンター。ハットの故郷、衛星ナー・シャッダの宇宙港に居をかまえる。自分で吹聴するだけの腕前はあるので、仲間にとっては心強い。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Danz Borin.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots.

2: If aboard a starship as a passenger, adds 1 to the starship's weapon destiny.

'''Lore:'''
A cocky gunner and bounty hunter. He keeps a residence at the spaceport of Nar Shaddaa, moon of the Hutt homeworld. He has the skill he boasts about, so his companions find him reliable.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese numbers the two options.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Danz Borin]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
